summary: Replaced Open/Hard stance with a hidden per-market direction value dir_<mkt> in design/proposals/2026-11-03-four-markets.md. Neutral options opt_a/opt_b per step, each with a gain, a cost, a bot stat change and a hidden signed nudge. Ending thresholds, echo and late-swing rules, 28-step option table, 'Why no option is dominant', and a handoff list for economy and story are in the core doc.

direction.value: dir_<mkt>, int -100..+100, hidden, one per market, both chains feed it
direction.modifiers: echo x1.25 if previous step in the same chain had the same sign; late swing x1.5 on the opposing nudge at B3/B4 when |dir| >= 40
direction.thresholds: dir >= 10 good; dir <= -10 bad; between: sign of last nudge decides; no step seen = good
direction.end_screen: no counts, labels or direction shown
